# Vendored front-end assets

Served locally so the contest works on networks that block or throttle public CDNs.
To upgrade, download the new version from the same source and update this list.

| Asset | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap (CSS, bundle JS) | 5.1.3 | cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3 |
| CodeMirror (core, python + clike modes, monokai theme) | 5.65.2 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.2 |
| Socket.IO client | 4.0.1 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/socket.io/4.0.1 |
| marked | 15.0.12 | cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15.0.12/marked.min.js |
| JSZip | 3.10.1 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1 |
